paper.title_en: SuperJEPA: Pretraining with a Supervision-Augmented Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for High Energy Physics
paper.abstract_en: Foundation models often obtain powerful results through very large unlabeled training datasets that dwarf available labeled datasets in size, but high energy physics already provides large samples of high-fidelity labeled simulation. We therefore ask whether self-supervised objectives improve over supervised pretraining alone when large labeled samples already exist. We introduce SuperJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architec- ture augmented with a supervised objective, and find improved downstream jet-tagging performance across multiple tasks, model sizes, and pretraining dataset sizes. The gains persist for both frozen and fine-tuned encoders, motivating predictive self-supervision in future large-scale particle-physics foundation models.
